bugClass: incorrect regex (lazy quantifiers cause the match to truncate before the prerelease/build suffix)
bugSummary: The prerelease/build segments used lazy quantifiers ({0,100}?), so extracting a full SemVer string captured only the MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH core and dropped the -prerelease+build suffix; e.g. '1.2.3-alpha.10.beta.0+build.unicorn.rainbow'.match(re)[0] returned '1.2.3'.
triggerInput: '1.2.3-alpha.10.beta.0+build.unicorn.rainbow'.match(semverRegex())[0] must equal the full string; buggy returns '1.2.3'. Also '1.1.2-prerelease+meta', '2.0.0+build.1848', '1.2.3-4'. (.test() returns true in both; plain '1.0.0' extracts correctly in both.)
